artifacts.summary: Implementation summary for settling the plan-level status marker vocabulary.

completion_data.completion_summary: Extended plan-format.md's plan-level Status vocabulary to {NOT STARTED, IMPLEMENTING, PARTIAL, BLOCKED, ABANDONED, COMPLETED} (dropping never-implemented IN PROGRESS), widened update-plan-status.sh's accept-set to match, and documented the intentional plan-level/phase-level marker asymmetry across status-markers.md, plan-format-enforcement.md, and artifact-formats.md.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo, the deployed .claude/ tree is a disposable build artifact (gitignored via `/.claude/` in .gitignore) regenerated from a git-tracked source store at agent-system/extensions/{ext}/ (path resolved per-extension via .claude-extensions.json's source_dir field). Any implementation task touching files under .claude/ must edit the source under agent-system/extensions/ first (that's the actual git-tracked deliverable) and mirror the change into the deployed .claude/ copy for immediate effect -- editing only the deployed copy silently loses the change on next regeneration and never gets committed.

Before running `git add <specific files> && git commit`, always check `git status --porcelain` first: if other files are already staged in the index from a prior uncommitted `git add` (e.g. a previous session's partial work), `git commit` will include ALL staged files, not just the ones just added, silently sweeping unrelated task artifacts into the current commit. Always verify the full staged set with `git status --porcelain` (look for the first-column letter, not just second-column) immediately before committing, not just after `git add`.
